A CONFLICT, not a migration — and the reason this one needs saying out loud. §3.6.1 prints TikTok's low end as 6.5% of the register; 35,000 ÷ 532,758 is 6.5695%, which is 6.6%, and the row directly beneath prints exactly that for the same 35,000. The `platform-sizing` figure computes, so it says 6.6%. Under hard rule 2 neither number has been changed: the TikTok band carries the Under review flag, and its note states in full that "§3.6.1 prints this low end as 6.5% — under review, C-18". THAT NOTE IS WHY THE LITERAL STILL REACHES PRINT, verified by emulating print on /reach. Flagging the conflict preserved the printed figure that correcting it would have destroyed. See CONFLICTS.md C-18; lib/figures/figures.test.ts asserts both halves of the disagreement so it cannot be closed by accident.
